svg.title: AD Privilege Escalation: Simulating real AD attack paths and privilege escalation chains.
svg.desc: AD Privilege Escalation. Simulating real AD attack paths and privilege escalation chains. Offense: Kerberoasting, AS-REP roasting, weak ACLs, weak passwords. Defense: identity hardening + BloodHound attack-path visibility. Tools: BloodHound, CrackMapExec, Impacket, John the Ripper.

g.text: Simulating real AD attack paths and privilege escalation chains.
OFFENSE › Kerberoasting, AS-REP roasting, weak ACLs, weak passwords
DEFENSE › identity hardening + BloodHound attack-path visibility
BloodHound attack path: 3 hops to tier-0
